name: August
focus: The Amazing Race 2.0 + Friendship Day + Independence Day
objective: Attendance-led renewals and upgrades; a 14-day Rookie intro; Friendship Day referrals; a one-day Independence Day annual.
strategy:
The Amazing Race 2.0.

Commercial job: Attendance-led renewals and upgrades; a 14-day Rookie intro; Friendship Day referrals; a one-day Independence Day annual.

Newcomer: Rookie Mistake (The Only Good One) (“Two weeks unlimited. The only rookie mistake is not trying.”). Clients with 5+ visits in month one buy at 93.5%. A 14-day window lets newcomers reach 5+ visits; the race gives them a reason. Effective 20% on conversion.

Renewal: At the Stroke of the Midnight Hour (“At the stroke of the midnight hour, your annual goes 25% off.”). Annual is the only membership where 25% is allowed. One day and a cap keep it an event, not a price.

Referral: Friends With Benefits (Strictly Fitness) (“Friends with benefits. Strictly fitness.”). Friendship Day falls on race day one. Referred friends convert 22–76% vs 4–6% for website leads.

Renewal: Medal Detector (“Finished the race? Your renewal just found gold.”). Race attendance lifts usage into the 75%+ band where renewal is 82–88%. August is Mumbai's second peak (Kwality ₹30.0L, Bandra ₹22.8L in Aug-26).
notes: Build: 82 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹9.1L; 90 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹21.0L; 40 winbacks = ₹4.6L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.4L. Offers carry ₹29.2L (77% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.
